items.source: This is a public equivalent of the protected defineClass(String, byte[], int, int, ProtectionDomain) method in ClassLoader which is traditionally invoked via reflection. A concrete implementation in a custom class loader should simply delegate to that protected method in order to make classloader-specific definitions publicly available without "illegal access" warnings on JDK 9+: return defineClass(name, b, 0, b.length, protectionDomain). Note that the JDK 9+ Lookup#defineClass method does not support a custom target class loader for the new definition; it rather always defines the class in the same class loader as the lookup's context class.
items.translation: 这是 `ClassLoader` 中受保护的 `defineClass(String, byte[], int, int, ProtectionDomain)` 方法的公共等效方法，该传统上通过反射调用。自定义类加载器中的具体实现应简单地委托给该受保护方法，以便在 JDK 9+ 上公开提供特定于类加载器的定义，而不会出现“非法访问”警告：`return defineClass(name, b, 0, b.length, protectionDomain)`。请注意，JDK 9+ 的 `Lookup#defineClass` 方法不支持为新的定义指定自定义目标类加载器；相反，它始终在查找上下文类的同一类加载器中定义该类。

items.source: If a ClassLoader does not implement this interface, then all the classes obtained from it should be considered as not reloadable (i.e. cacheable).
items.translation: 如果 ClassLoader 未实现此接口，则从其获取的所有类都应被视为不可重新加载（即可缓存）。

items.source: Typically used to check whether the result may be cached (for this ClassLoader) or whether it should be reobtained every time. The default implementation always returns false.
items.translation: 通常用于检查结果是否可以缓存（针对此 ClassLoader），或者是否每次都需要重新获取。默认实现始终返回 `false`。

items.source: The default implementation returns the local ClassLoader reference as-is. In case of a reloadable or other selectively overriding ClassLoader which commonly deals with unaffected classes from a base application class loader, this should get implemented to return the original ClassLoader that the present loader got derived from (for example, through return getParent();).
items.translation: 默认实现直接返回本地 ClassLoader 引用。对于可重新加载的或其他选择性覆盖的 ClassLoader（通常处理来自基础应用程序 ClassLoader 的未受影响类），应实现为返回当前派生的原始 ClassLoader（例如，通过 `return getParent();`）。

items.source:
This gets specifically used in Spring's AOP framework to determine the
class loader for a specific proxy in case the target class has not been
defined in the present class loader. In case of a reloadable class loader,
we prefer the base application class loader for proxying general classes
not defined in the reloadable class loader itself.
items.translation: 这专门用于 Spring 的 AOP 框架，以确定特定代理的类加载器，如果目标类未在当前的类加载器中定义。对于可重新加载的类加载器，我们首选基础应用程序类加载器来代理未在该可重新加载类加载器本身中定义的通用类。

items.source: LinkageError - in case of a bad class definition
items.translation: LinkageError - 在类定义错误的情况下

items.source: SecurityException - in case of an invalid definition attempt
items.translation: SecurityException - 在尝试无效定义的情况下

items.source: UnsupportedOperationException - in case of a custom definition attempt not being possible (thrown by the default implementation in this interface)
items.translation: UnsupportedOperationException - 在无法尝试自定义定义时（由本接口的默认实现抛出）

items.source: clazz - the class to check (usually loaded from this ClassLoader)
items.translation: clazz - 要检查的类（通常从此 ClassLoader 加载）

items.source: whether the class should be expected to appear in a reloaded version (with a different Class object) later on
items.translation: 类是否预期会在稍后以不同的 `Class` 对象出现在重新加载的版本中

items.source: protectionDomain - the protection domain for the class, if any
the original ClassLoader (the same reference by default)
items.translation: 原始 ClassLoader（默认情况下为同一引用）

items.source:
Return the original ClassLoader for this SmartClassLoader, or potentially
the present loader itself if it is self-sufficient.
items.translation: 返回此 SmartClassLoader 的原始 ClassLoader，或者如果它自给自足，则返回其自身。

items.source: Determine whether the given class is reloadable (in this ClassLoader).
items.translation: 确定给定类是否可重新加载（在此 ClassLoader 中）。

items.source: Define a custom class (typically a CGLIB proxy class) in this class loader.
items.translation: 在此类加载器中定义一个自定义类（通常是 CGLIB 代理类）。
